title: Patch: hand, deck and graveyard triggers read alike
notes: Animosity (S+ #89), Corpse Eater (Core #89) and Legacy: Corpse Eater (TG #56) print their trigger from where the card waits as "While this is in your <zone>: …", as every other such card does (R5038000, §6.2); their Chinese faces follow. Wording only: no card plays differently.

player.title: Hand, deck and graveyard triggers read alike
text: Animosity now reads "While this is in your deck: When your exile has 5 cards, cast this."
Corpse Eater and Legacy: Corpse Eater now read "While this is in your hand: When a Unit dies, this gains its attack and health."
No card plays differently: only the words changed, in English and Chinese.
